children: American Water sold $500.0 million of 5.550% Senior Notes due 2033 and received approximately $496.6 million in net proceeds.
AWCC, American Water’s finance subsidiary, priced $500.0M of 5.550% senior notes due 2033 underwritten Sept 14, 2026.
Net proceeds of ~ $496.6M (after underwriting discounts, before offering expenses) were received at closing on Sept 16, 2026.
Proceeds will repay $250.0M of AWCC 3.000% senior notes maturing Dec 1, 2026, fund regulated-business loans, reduce commercial paper, and for general corporate purposes.
The notes benefit from a Support Agreement from American Water and were issued under the existing indenture and registered Form S-3 filings.
